{{Wireless adapter |brand=Acrowave Systems |model=AWL-1100C |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=04/04/2001 |manuf_country=Korea |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |if=PCMCIA (16-bit) |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |fcc_id=PE6AWL-1100C |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Harris |chip1_model=HFA3841 |chip2_brand=Intersil |chip2_model=HFA3861B |chip3_brand=Intersil |chip3_model=HFA3683A |flags=schematics |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=b |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui= |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} "Acrowave" and "AWL-1100C Rev 3" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
Per the FCC manual, the receive sensitivity of the device is as follows.. *-87 dBm @ 1Mbps *-85 dBm @ 2Mbps *-84 dBm @ 5.5Mbps *-81 dBm @ 11Mbps
Per the FCC external photos, this device was manufactured in Korea.
